title: Create Invoice is disabled with the Credit Hold tooltip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the Credit Hold credit term.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Hover over Create Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • Create Invoice is disabled.

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [customer B's name], is on Credit Hold"

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R8: “The Create Invoice action is disabled with M2 as its tooltip.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “M2 | Create Invoice when the Bill To is on Credit Hold | "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [Bill To], is on Credit Hold" | Banner with "Change Bill To"; Create Invoice tooltip; error toast with "Change Bill To"”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Create the invoice | Allowed, unless the Bill To is on Credit Hold (M2) or requires a PO and Customer PO is empty | n/a | No invoice”
